candidates.name: Karachaganak-Orenburg Sour Gas Pipelines (KOTS gas lines)
candidates.sponsor: Karachaganak Petroleum Operating (KPO) / Gazprom Pererabotka (Orenburg GPP)
candidates.to: Orenburg Gas Processing Plant (Orenburg oblast, Russia)

evidence.note: KOTS = five pipelines of 140 km from Karachaganak to Orenburg Gas Plant in Russia; two 28-inch lines carry sour gas, three 14-inch lines are liquid/dual-service (unstabilised liquid or sour gas); predate Karachaganak phase 2.
Karachaganak-Orenburg transportation: two 140 km 28-inch sour gas export pipelines, one 14-inch liquid line, two 14-inch dual-service lines.
Orenburg GPP resumes intake of gas from Karachaganak field (the cross-border flow these lines carry).

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for the Karachaganak-Orenburg gas lines (roster has Orenburg-Novopskov P0791, Soyuz P0761, Orenburg-Samara P2364 etc., none starting at Karachaganak). GEM may track the condensate line in GOIT (Karachaganak-Orenburg Condensate Pipeline) - check oil tracker; gas lines (2 x 28 in, plus 2 dual-service 14 in) are separate gas entries. Length ~140 km (some sources say 120 km); Russian segment only ~15-40 km of that is in Russia (border crossing in Orenburg oblast), so Russia-scope length is uncertain; cross-border line, Russian end at Orenburg GPP (Volga FD).
